text: Deposit gone, for wear and tear?
You moved out. The landlord blames faded paint.
Keep the flat as you got it, except normal wear and tear.
Repainting? The landlord's job, whatever the agreement says.
Damage you cause, like a broken window, can be deducted.
The rest is due when the landlord takes the empty flat back.
Photograph every room, moving in and out. Get deductions in writing.
